overview: 67 official Group 1 Qs (2008–2024) on physical geography: solar system, time, seasons, interior, landforms, atmosphere, climate, oceans and resources. Up to 2019 almost all one-liners (term → definition, region → mineral); 2023–24 add statement-based, match and A-R items on landforms, clouds, winds and ocean deposits. Two items (local time, atmospheric order) were repeated word for word.

possibility.angle: Earth in the solar system – astronomy terms and eclipses
possibility.what_they_ask: unit meaning (light year), field of a scientist (Copernicus), eclipse dates and types, Big Bang evidence

possibility.angle: Motions of the Earth – perihelion, Coriolis, tides
possibility.what_they_ask: perihelion/aphelion, cause of wind deflection, daily tide delay

possibility.angle: Concept of time – latitude, longitude, local time
possibility.what_they_ask: local-time arithmetic across hemispheres, direction latitudes run, who first divided the circle into 360°
dates of solstices/equinoxes, where the Sun is overhead, Uttarayana span, latitude band with largest seasonal contrast
layer names, named discontinuities (Moho), direct vs indirect sources of information

possibility.angle: Major landforms – fluvial, glacial, karst, volcanic, tectonic
possibility.what_they_ask: agent → landform, intrusive forms (batholith, laccolith, phacolith, sill, dyke), gorge vs canyon, orogeny vs epeirogeny, volcanic mountain, karst site in AP, geyser park
gas percentages and order, basis of layering (temperature), tropopause, halo optics

possibility.angle: Elements and factors of climate – insolation, albedo, winds, clouds
possibility.what_they_ask: terms (insolation, albedo), pressure belts (doldrums), trade wind direction, cloud type → appearance, instrument names, hydrological-cycle steps

possibility.evidence: 0 official Qs (fronts appear inside the 2024 extra-tropical cyclone item)
possibility.what_they_ask: natural targets judging by neighbouring items: source-region codes (cP, mT), warm/cold/occluded front weather, frontogenesis in mid-latitudes
regional names of tropical cyclones, features of extra-tropical cyclones, named cyclones and landfall areas
greenhouse effect location, ice-age epoch, attribution of a recent study
warm vs cold currents, guyot/seamount/atoll, hypsometric curve, terrigenous deposits, tsunami cause, coastless sea, coral reef epithet
flood-exposed population and hazard-prone coastline figures (NDMA numbers)
mining region → mineral (Weipa, Nikopol, Karaganda, Lake Superior, Katanga), top producer (Chile copper), offshore oil on the shelf

traps.trap: Swaps a look-alike term within one family
traps.spot: Options or statements using laccolith/phacolith, orogeny/epeirogeny, cirrus/cumulonimbus
traps.fix: Laccolith = dome with flat base; phacolith = wavy lens in folds; orogeny = mountains, epeirogeny = continents; halos form in thin cirrus/cirrostratus
traps.pyq: 'Phacoliths [...] dome-shaped' false → I, III, IV [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#91]; 'Orogeny is continental building' incorrect [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#93]; halo 'cumulonimbus' false [group1-prelims-2024-paper2#75]

traps.trap: Reverses a gradient or a wind direction
traps.spot: 'gradual increase in coarseness from shore', 'trade winds north-west', 'doldrums strong winds'
traps.fix: Sediment gets finer seaward; NH trades are NE; doldrums are a calm belt
traps.pyq: Statement II false → I, III, IV [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#100]; both false → 'None of them' [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#96]

traps.trap: Swaps the rank of a minor gas
traps.spot: Order options putting CO₂ above argon

traps.trap: Denies the defining feature of a system
traps.spot: Negative item where one option says 'do not have' a known feature
traps.fix: Extra-tropical cyclones are frontal (warm + cold fronts); tropical ones are non-frontal
traps.pyq: 'do not have a clear frontal system' is incorrect [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#97]

traps.trap: Reverses which form is the extension of which
traps.fix: A canyon is the extended variant of a gorge, not the reverse

traps.trap: Gives a true but different reason in A-R
traps.spot: Both statements true, R names a function rather than the basis of a name
traps.fix: 'Rainforests of the sea' refers to biodiversity; wave protection is another service
traps.pyq: Both correct, II not the explanation [group1-prelims-2024-paper2#76]

traps.fix: Cold currents run equatorward on western coasts of continents (Humboldt, Benguela, California, Canary); warm ones poleward on eastern coasts (Brazil, Agulhas, Kuroshio)

traps.spot: 'direct source of information about the interior'
traps.fix: Direct = mining, drilling, volcanic material; indirect = seismic waves, gravity, magnetism, meteorites

techniques.name: Longitude-time arithmetic
techniques.how: Difference in longitude × 4 min = time difference. Across the prime meridian add the two longitudes; the place to the east is ahead.
techniques.example: 60°W to 90°E [...] = 150° × 4 = 600 min = 10 h; B is east, so 10 a.m. + 10 h = 8 p.m. [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#111]; same Q [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#110]

techniques.name: Agent → landform sorting
techniques.how: Name the agent first (river, glacier, wind, groundwater, sea), then decide erosional or depositional; drop options of the wrong agent.
techniques.example: Till, moraine, boulder clay are ice-laid → glacial [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#134]; stalactites/stalagmites → groundwater [group1-prelims-2008#24]

techniques.name: Calendar anchor for Sun's position
techniques.how: Fix four dates: 21 Mar and 23 Sep (equator), 21 Jun (Cancer), 22 Dec (Capricorn). Northward movement = Uttarayana (Dec → Jun).
techniques.example: Winter solstice Dec 22, summer Jun 21, vernal Mar 21, autumnal Sep 23 → 'I II III IV' [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#91]; Uttarayana → 23 Dec–21 Jun [group1-prelims-2008#62]

techniques.name: Match-list anchor on the most distinctive pair
techniques.how: Fix the pair you are surest of (cumulus = cauliflower), then check which codes keep it.
techniques.example: D-III keeps options 2 only (option 1 has D-IV, 3 D-I, 4 D-II) → A-II, B-I, C-IV, D-III [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#95]

techniques.name: Region–mineral grid
techniques.how: Learn mineral regions in pairs of the same country/basin: Krivoy Rog iron vs Nikopol manganese; Karaganda/Kuznetsk coal; Mesabi iron vs Sudbury nickel; Weipa/Gove bauxite.
techniques.example: Nikopol → manganese, not chromite/nickel [group1-prelims-2010#20]; Karaganda → coal [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#108]

techniques.name: Discontinuity ladder
techniques.how: Recall the sequence downward: Conrad (within crust), Moho (crust–mantle), Repetti (within mantle), Gutenberg (mantle–core), Lehmann (outer–inner core).
techniques.example: Crust–mantle boundary → Moho; Gutenberg is deeper [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#92]

confusions.remember: Dome vs wavy lens in folds vs saucer
Canyon = extended gorge with step-like sides, in sedimentary rock
W Pacific vs Atlantic/E Pacific vs Australia
Non-frontal, sea only, intense vs frontal, land or sea, larger area
Closest to the Sun in NH winter
Longest total of the century vs longest annular of the millennium
Hydration is chemical weathering, not part of the cycle
Both calm; doldrums low pressure, horse latitudes high pressure
Sargasso is the coastless sea, bounded by currents

anchors: 21 Mar / 23 Sep – Sun over Equator; 21 Jun – Cancer; 22 Dec – Capricorn
Atmospheric layers are defined by temperature profile
Tide comes ~52 minutes later each day
NH trade winds blow from the NE; Coriolis deflects right in NH
Halo radius ~22°, from ice crystals in thin cirrus-type clouds
Offshore oil lies mostly on continental shelves
India: ~5,700 km of coast hazard-prone; ~200 million exposed to floods (per key)
Tsunamis are chiefly caused by sea-floor fault movement (earthquakes)
checklist: Which family of terms is this – and which twin term could be swapped in?
Is a direction or gradient stated (NE/NW, coarse→fine, warm→cold)? Check it against the rule
For time items, do the 4-minute arithmetic before reading options
For landforms, name the agent and whether it erodes or deposits
For A-R, check that R is the reason for the specific claim in A, not just another true fact
For mineral/region items, recall the region's main mineral and its neighbour region's
